name: iBeat_mixed_questions
description: Mixed post-trial questions: 50% sync-detection, ~16.7% each of flash-detection, left/right, and image-identification. Peaks-only (ECG) input signal, with the default peak-envelope timings carried explicitly so this preset doesn't depend on whatever config.js happens to default to. Eye tracking left to the experimenter controls.

questions.text: Was the fish in sync with your breathing?
Did you see the pink fish flashing?
Was the fish left or right?
Did you see the pufferfish or the starfish?
